firms.name: FTMO
firms.asset_class: Forex / CFD (incl. indices, metals, some stocks)
firms.backing_note: Longest-running major retail prop brand; fee refund on first payout; large public payout history.

automation.summary: EAs on MT5 + cTrader Open API (C#/Python SDKs). Broadly allowed.
automation.api: cTrader Open API / MT5 EA (not a first-party REST brokerage API)
automation.ai_agents: Yes via EA or cTrader API — must avoid HFT / latency arb / toxic flow.
automation.restrictions: No HFT, no latency arbitrage; news restricted on Normal funded accounts; strategy audits happen.

rules.payout: On-demand after ~14 days from first funded trade; 80→90% split

firms.fit_for_us: Best default for our equity/CFD residual-mom agent: static DD, no consistency trap, mature automation path.
firms.watchouts: Informal concentration reviews have denied some wildly one-day PnL profiles — still diversify winning days.

firms.name: E8 Markets
firms.backing_note: Frequently ranked among more transparent CFD props; EAs allowed without pre-approval for standard strategies.

automation.summary: EAs / trade management across platforms; activity caps exist.
automation.ai_agents: Yes for standard algos; same EA across many accounts can trigger bans.
automation.restrictions: ~2,000 server requests/day caps in some plans; no HFT / latency arb; don't fingerprint-copy the same bot across lots of accounts.

rules.eval: Flexible / often no hard time pressure (plan-dependent)
rules.consistency: Generally lighter than The5ers/FundedNext — verify per plan
rules.payout: On-demand after initial waiting period (often ~14d); up to 100% split on some ladders

firms.fit_for_us: Strong algo runner-up when we want on-demand payouts and static DD tighter than 10%.
firms.watchouts: Rule set is plan-heavy — lock the exact account type before coding risk limits.

firms.name: Propr
firms.backing_note: Onchain settlement + public payout explorer is unusual transparency; younger firm than FTMO — treat as higher platform risk.

automation.summary: First-party REST + Python/JS SDKs; marketed explicitly for AI agents.
automation.ai_agents: Best-in-class for Cursor-style agents (direct API, no MT bridge).
automation.restrictions: Geo bans (US/UK/OFAC etc.); product is perps not cash equities.

rules.payout: On-demand USDC onchain; published tx hashes

firms.fit_for_us: Choose if we port the agent to perps and need a real API. Not a drop-in for Robinhood equities.
firms.watchouts: Newer venue; tighter static DD; different market microstructure than residual-mom equities.

firms.name: Tradeify
firms.backing_note: US futures prop (est. 2024); large advertised payout volume / strong Trustpilot; one-time fees, $0 activation on current marketing.

automation.summary: Personal bots / EAs allowed if you are sole owner+developer; register/verify uniqueness; no rented commercial bots; no HFT.
automation.api: Tradovate / Rithmic / NinjaTrader (+ TradeSea); TradingView webhooks via bridges
automation.ai_agents: Yes for our in-house agent — must not share the same bot across other firms; expect code/demo if flagged.
automation.restrictions: Sole-owner/single-firm bot rule; hold-time / anti-HFT (majority of profit from trades held >~5–10s); no latency games.

rules.eval: Growth / Select one-step evals, or Lightning instant funded
rules.daily_loss: Plan-dependent (Growth soft DLL; Select Flex often none; Select Daily / Lightning have DLL)
rules.max_dd: EOD trailing that locks to start+$100 once far enough ahead — then behaves static
rules.consistency: Select funded: NONE (best payout path). Growth funded ~35%. Lightning funded progressive ~20→25→30%. Select eval ~40%.
rules.min_days: Select eval typically ≥3 days; Lightning skips eval
rules.payout: Select Daily = daily; Select Flex = every ~5 winning days; fast processing; ~90% split (often 100% on first $15K tranche — verify)

firms.fit_for_us: Best futures prop in this catalog for an in-house AI agent if we port to CME: Select eval → Flex funded (personal bots OK + consistency REMOVED). Not a drop-in for equity residual-mom — needs a futures rebuild.
firms.watchouts: EOD trailing fights open risk until the floor locks near start+$100; skip Growth/Lightning if you hate consistency (they keep it funded); sole-owner/single-firm bot rule — prove uniqueness if flagged; 50%+ of profit from trades held >~5–10s (anti-HFT).

automation.restrictions: HFT / tick abuse banned; API connection fees; overnight limits vary by product.

rules.max_dd: Trailing styles common; some plans lock toward static

rules.consistency: Often ~40% best-day share before payout (doesn't always breach — can block payout)
rules.min_days: Often ~10 trading days before first payout
rules.payout: Weekly / bi-weekly cycles common; first $10K often 100% on some marketing plans

firms.fit_for_us: Only if we rebuild as a futures strategy. Trailing + consistency need agent-level gates.
firms.watchouts: Trailing DD fights momentum systems; consistency can delay payouts after a hot day.

firms.backing_note: Strong Trustpilot reputation in futures props; updated policy to allow full automation (mid-2025+).

automation.ai_agents: Yes if CME-compliant and not spamming (~200 trades/day soft ceiling reported).

rules.eval: Futures eval plans; some no daily loss limit
rules.consistency: Plan-dependent; many futures firms use 30–40% best-day payout gates
rules.payout: Fast cycles / next-day on some marketing; no activation fee on flagship pitches

firms.fit_for_us: Viable futures agent venue; trailing DD still a mismatch for equity RM as-is.

firms.name: The5ers
firms.backing_note: High trust / long-term scaling reputation; slower / stricter risk box.

automation.summary: EAs allowed only if you own the source code.
automation.ai_agents: Yes if agent code is ours end-to-end — good cultural fit for in-house research.
automation.restrictions: Purchased closed-source EAs are a ban risk; HFT/arb banned.

rules.eval: Hyper Growth / High Stakes variants; ~6% targets
rules.payout: Monthly; split scales toward 100% at high tiers

firms.fit_for_us: Only after we can run a much lower-vol book (CPPI / vol8 class).

firms.name: FundedNext
firms.backing_note: Large payout marketing presence; CFD automation is MT-only.

automation.restrictions: Hyperactivity caps; banned strategy lists; news profit discounts on funded CFD.

rules.consistency: Common 30–40% best-day rules on some models — payout blocker
rules.payout: Bi-weekly / monthly styles; high advertised splits

firms.fit_for_us: Usable if MT-hosted and we enforce consistency in the agent.

avoid.reason: Widely reported: fully autonomous set-and-forget bots restricted; semi-auto only on funded — poor fit for an unsupervised AI agent.

avoid.name: Take Profit Trader
avoid.reason: Explicit discretionary/no-bots posture in policy writeups — agent/API path is a denial risk.

avoid.name: Alpha Capital Group (full auto)

strategy_books.label: Original Resid Mom
strategy_books.thesis: Equal-weight Tech 80% — too wild for most prop DD boxes.

strategy_books.label: Optimized V2
strategy_books.thesis: Confidence sizing — still rejects a hard 35% retail gate, worse for 10% prop floors.

strategy_books.label: V2 + Anti-crowd + vol 10%
strategy_books.thesis: Best dd-lab survivor historically — still size carefully for 5%/10% prop limits.

strategy_books.label: Prop-compliant agent (FTMO-shaped gates)
strategy_books.thesis: Same signal as V2+anti-crowd+vol10, plus daily halt + soft/hard path DD buffers sized under 5%/10% static rules.

playbook.objective: Pass eval + stay funded + get paid — without rule-denial on automation or consistency.
playbook.futures_path: If rebuilding as CME futures: Tradeify Select eval → Flex funded (personal sole-owner bots OK; no consistency once funded). Prefer over Growth/Lightning.
playbook.signal: Optimized V2 residual momentum + anti-crowd corr + 10% vol target (from dd-lab).

risk_box_ftmo_shaped.per_trade_risk: ≤0.5–0.75% of account (static DD grows only if you don't trail)
risk_box_ftmo_shaped.daily_halt: ≤1.0–1.5% day loss (hard stop in agent before firm 5% trip)
risk_box_ftmo_shaped.path_hard: Flat by ~8.5% path DD (leave buffer under 10% static)
risk_box_ftmo_shaped.consistency_self_rule: Cap any day at ≤25–30% of MTD positive PnL even if firm has no rule
risk_box_ftmo_shaped.news: Stand down ± minutes around red-folder events on Normal FTMO
risk_box_ftmo_shaped.automation_hygiene: Own all code; no commercial 'challenge passer' EA fingerprints; stable IP/VPS; no copy-across-accounts
risk_box_ftmo_shaped.trade_count: Keep activity human-plausible — avoid hyperactivity / server spam caps

payout_checklist: Confirm automation clause on the exact account type (eval AND funded).
Simulate static/trailing floor on your historical path before buying.
Enforce daily halt in software — most breaches are daily, not max DD.
Spread profits across days before requesting payout.
Keep a written change-log of strategy versions (audit defense).
Never run the identical closed-source bot on a web of borrowed accounts.
On Tradeify: register sole ownership of the bot; stay off Growth/Lightning if you want zero consistency.

warnings: Retail prop trading has very low first-attempt pass rates industry-wide — size challenge fees as R&D cost.
Trailing DD (many futures props) fights momentum systems; prefer static floors for our stack.
Consistency rules don't always breach the account — they silently block payouts until diluted.
Native AI REST APIs (e.g. Propr) are rare; most 'API' paths are MT5 EA or cTrader/Tradovate bridges.
Our equity residual-mom research is closest to CFD index/stock products at FTMO/E8 — not a 1:1 Robinhood transfer.
Tradeify Select Flex is the payout-friendly futures path here (no funded consistency) — but trailing EOD DD + futures-only still require a strategy port.
